title: NLO – Mill Feed Off Stoppage Interlocks

fields.latestPosition: Draft 24/09 after the 23/09 NLO mill feed-off event – not yet in register.
fields.why:
On 23/09, the NLO Ball Mill continued running without Precon feed due to the HPGR chiller pump being out of service. The job was initially expected to take approximately 1 hour; however, it was 7 hours before plant feed was restored, with the mill running for the full duration. The Middlings Feeder continued feeding the mill for approximately 4 hours.
This is detrimental to the mill lining system as it causes unnecessary wear. It also results in unnecessary grinding media consumption and power usage.
fields.design:
- Create a process interlock on the Middlings Feeder 410-FE-1140 when HPGR feed has been off for 20 minutes, based on HPGR Drive Status = Off.
- Stop 410-FE-1140 first, as continued middlings feed will delay or prevent the mill discharge density from dropping below the low-density trip setpoint.
- When the 20-minute feed-off condition is met, set Mill Feed Line Water 410-FIC-1170 to Auto at 20 m3/hr to flush the mill. This should be just a SP change and still can be modified by CRO.
- Generate a high-priority operator popup advising that the Middlings Feeder has been stopped, Mill Feed Line Water has been placed in Auto at 20 m3/hr SP, and the mill will stop if Mill Discharge Density 410-DIT-1295 drops below 1.2 SG.
- After 410-FE-1140 has stopped, If Mill Discharge Density 410-DIT-1295 drops below 1.2 SG (26% solids), start a 5-minute countdown timer to stop Ball Mill Main Drive 410-ML-1171.
- If 410-DIT-1295 remains below 1.2 SG at the end of the 5-minute countdown, stop Ball Mill Main Drive 410-ML-1171 via process interlock.
- Once the Mill has stopped reset Mill Feed Line Water 410-FIC-1170 to Remote SP .
- The 5-minute countdown timer should be visible to CRO operators
- Setup and visibility should be similar to the existing PDSH alarm that stops 410-ML-1171 Main Drive after 12 hours as an interlock.
fields.impact: CROs get a popup and a visible countdown when the mill runs without feed. The mill stops automatically if discharge density stays below 1.2 SG for 5 minutes.
